input:
; Product fixture: SourceRevision identity follows source coordinates and
; content. RefTransition carries moving commit membership separately, so an
; unchanged file retains its extraction identity across a ref advance.
(: Repository
   (* (: url text)))

(: WatchedRef
   (* (: repository Repository)
      (: name text)))

(: SourceCoordinate
   (* (: repository Repository)
      (: watched_ref WatchedRef)
      (: path text)))

(: SourceRevision
   (* (: coordinate SourceCoordinate)
      (: content_hash text)))

(: RefTransition
   (* (: watched_ref WatchedRef)
      (: old_sha text)
      (: new_sha text)))

(: Span
   (* (: source SourceRevision)
      (: start int)
      (: end int)))

(: Node
   (* (: primary Span)
      (: secondary Span)
      (: kind text)))

; Unrelated points into the selected closure but is not reachable from a root.
(: Unrelated
   (* (: span Span)
      (: note text)))

; Sum fixture verifies that reachable variants use the same ordered field and
; dependency protocol as products.
(: SpanChoice
   (+ (: first Span)
      (: second Span)))

(: ChoiceRoot
   (* (: choice SpanChoice)))

; Application-authored capability and policy products. Literal capabilities
; make the selection protocol explicit without sharing source-module callables.
(: SharedTextDictionary (*))

(: NodeStorageRoot
   (* (: capability "storage-root-v1")
      (: target Node)))

(: RefTransitionStorageRoot
   (* (: capability "storage-root-v1")
      (: target RefTransition)))

(: ChoiceStorageRoot
   (* (: capability "storage-root-v1")
      (: target ChoiceRoot)))

(: TextDictionarySelection
   (* (: capability "scalar-dictionary-v1")
      (: scalar text)
      (: dictionary SharedTextDictionary)))

(: PlainNodeKind
   (* (: capability "plain-field-v1")
      (: owner Node)
      (: position 2)))

(: InternedPolicy
   (* (: capability "interned-storage-policy-v1")
      (: root NodeStorageRoot)
      (: dictionary TextDictionarySelection)))

(: PlainKindPolicy
   (* (: capability "interned-storage-policy-v1")
      (: root NodeStorageRoot)
      (: dictionary TextDictionarySelection)
      (: storage_plain PlainNodeKind)))

(: RefTransitionPolicy
   (* (: capability "interned-storage-policy-v1")
      (: root RefTransitionStorageRoot)
      (: dictionary TextDictionarySelection)))

(: SumPolicy
   (* (: capability "interned-storage-policy-v1")
      (: root ChoiceStorageRoot)
      (: dictionary TextDictionarySelection)))
